## About
Loris & Eddie's Auto Repair is a full service shop in Denver, run by Loris and Eddie Zarooki. We've been working on cars from the same centrally located spot on S Jason St for a long time, and we plan to keep doing it the same way: reliable, affordable work and advice you can count on.
We handle everything from oil changes to complete engine rebuilds, plus brakes, tires, transmissions, air conditioning and electrical work. If it has to do with your car, big or small, come to us first.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 244 Google reviews. We'd like to earn your trust too.

## Services
- Factory scheduled maintenance: Keeping up with the maintenance your car's maker recommends.
- Check engine light diagnostics: Computer diagnostics to find out why the light is on and what it will take to fix it.
- Brake jobs: Brake work to keep your stops safe.
- Engine repair: Engine work, big or small.
- Transmission service and repair: Transmission service, new and rebuilt transmissions, clutches, axles and differentials.
- Tires: Tire rotation, mounting, balancing, flat repair and replacement.
- Air conditioning service and repair: Getting your air conditioning blowing cold again.
- Safety and emissions inspections: Safety and emissions inspections for your vehicle.
- Pre purchase inspections: Looking at a used car? We'll inspect it before you buy. One reviewer who flew in to look at a car said we walked him through everything we found.

## FAQ
Q: What are your weekday hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Give us a call to set up a visit.

Q: Do you buy and sell used cars?
A: Yes. We also buy and sell used cars through Zarooki Motors.

Q: Do you have any coupons or specials?
A: We post current coupons and promotions on our specials page. Ask us when you call.

Q: Will you work on my import?
A: One reviewer said we're one of the few shops he's been able to take his RHD import to. Call and tell us what you drive.
